scope: G0.6a DRY-3 current builder floor/ranking check for controlled Flap self-launch

blockrazor.rule: Average gas price of a BSC bundle must be >= 0.05 gwei; mempool transactions are excluded from the average calculation.

fortyeightclub.ranking_rule: Current public bundle-status documentation describes priority as included transaction gas fees after adjustments plus direct transfers. No explicit public minimum bundle gas-price floor was found in the current public builder documentation checked for this DRY.
fortyeightclub.policy: Do not label 1 gwei as a 48Club minimum.

stage1_policy_note: Final one-attempt minimal-spend policy: 0.05 gwei equals the strictest explicit verified BlockRazor floor and the 2026-10-11 observed BSC RPC gas price during the minimum-spend probe. This is a DarkBot signed-gas policy, not a claimed 48Club minimum.
non_claims: This evidence does not prove valid bundle inclusion.
This evidence does not prove hidden undocumented 48Club requirements.
Real G0.7 ordering/acquisition evidence is still required.

minimum_spend_probe.rationale: Smallest evidence-backed gas price and lowest BUY value already locally probed with positive expected/min output; full G0.6 DRY must requalify exact final bytes before funding.
